E0.2_blend.interpretation: brush.xy = sum(vel * k^2); brush.w = sum(k^2); brush.z = sum(0.01 * k^2). Mean deposited velocity m = brush.xy / brush.w is exact. brush.w is proportional to particle count only up to the sub-pixel spread reported above.

E0.4_warmup.criterion: split-half spectral drift <= sqrt(2) * within-window scatter

E1_timescales.why_even_only: velocity reverses on consecutive steps whenever force outweighs retained momentum, not only under negative drag; odd lags therefore measure that reversal rather than heading decorrelation
